documents.title: Cleburne County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 13 pages. Amounts are the 'TOTAL 2026 BUDGET' (only amount column) in Ordinance 2025-23 Section 1 column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
